body:
WHAT
toWireMessages in engine/providers/src/openai-compat.ts sends an assistant message's text and tool_calls and drops its thinking blocks, so the model never sees its own earlier reasoning. It now also sends the message's reasoning (its thinking blocks joined in order) as `reasoning_content` on that assistant message; a message with no reasoning carries no such field. `reasoning_content` joins the negotiable fields: an endpoint whose 400 names it gets the same request again without it, and the provider remembers for the rest of its life, exactly as for stream_options. The native Ollama transport is unchanged (its templates decide what history they render); its comment no longer claims to match this one.

WHY
Field run 2026-09-24/25 (agentics/test7, MiMo-V2.6-Pro) and the GLM-5.3 run of 2026-09-23: the owner's main complaint — "all the work is done silently in reasoning, then the other steps take 0s". The model planned everything in one huge reasoning block (71k characters over 13 minutes before the first tool call) and then fired its tool calls in bursts. MiMo's own documentation requires reasoning_content to be passed back on every assistant message with tool calls ("If historical reasoning_content is missing, the model's context will be incomplete, which may result in decreased instruction following and increased hallucinations"); GLM-5's Preserved Thinking and Fireworks' interleaved thinking rely on the same field ("If you … omit the reasoning_content field, the model will not have access to its previous reasoning process"). A model that loses its plan at every step is pushed to plan everything first.

WHERE
engine/providers/src/openai-compat.ts — WireMessage, NegotiableField, rejectedField(), buildBody(), toWireMessages(). engine/providers/src/ollama.ts — comment only.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (net) A conversation whose assistant message holds reasoning, text and a tool call reaches a real 127.0.0.1 endpoint with that message's reasoning_content equal to its reasoning, beside content and tool_calls; an assistant message with no reasoning carries no reasoning_content.
2. (net) An endpoint that answers 400 naming reasoning_content gets the same request once more without the field, the turn completes, and a later request no longer sends it.
2b. (net) An endpoint whose 400 DEMANDS reasoning_content ("is required") is not taught to drop it: no re-send without the field, and its own 400 surfaces.
3. (net) Through the real Engine and Session on a real OpenAICompatProvider: the reasoning the endpoint streamed with a tool call in the first response comes back verbatim as reasoning_content in the second request of the same turn.
